payload.core_mechanism_summary: Scan rows and transposed columns, count consecutive '.' segments, add (length - k + 1) for length >= k. If k==1, count all '.' seats.
payload.rationale: The solution implicitly considers all possible k-length contiguous placements (exhaustive check), which corresponds to complete search. Among the subtypes, permutation enumeration best fits the notion of enumerating seat arrangements, though the code uses arithmetic rather than explicit permutation generation.
